main_text.p: quæ hic Neotheologus attexit posteà, vt absurdum vnum ex alio deducat.

4 Iam ad fabricandâ hanc egregiam (si superis placet) personalis vnionis doctrinam, nullius Concilij definitionem, Colos.2. nullius Patris sententiam, nullam ratio-Thess.31.nem, autoritatem denique nullam, hic supercilij Artifex producit, sed vno tantùm Scripturæ loco fraudulenter exposito, hoc phantasma suum adumbrare conatur,& non tam persuadere, quàm fidei articulum sua solius autoritate id efficere sperat.

5 Verùm, vt simul & imperitia & impietas noua coarguatur, Primùm ostendemus istiusmodi potentiæ & Maiestatis vnionem, aut plenitudinis diuinitatis communicationem, qualem ille fingit, minimè factam fuisse, imò ne fieri quidem vllo pacto potuisse. Tum vt concedamus factam illam fuisse, tamen eam nec personalem esse, nec ad personalem constituendam sufficere docebimus. Postremò Christum secùdum assumptam naturam non vbique, sed in cælo tantùm, & in Eucharistiæ sacramento præsentem adesse planum faciemus.

page.notes: Marginal references right: "Coloss. 2." and "Thess. 2." as far as legible; the "Thess." reference is partly cut and may read differently. Left margin contains show-through and edge fragments of the adjacent page, not transcribed. Printed text uses long s throughout, rendered as s; "Eucharistiæ" is partly obscured in the scan.
